bullets.text: A road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity halted traffic, and Metrowater officials must inspect underground utility assets.
Cyclone Murasu triggered heavy rain and a high sea surge in Chennai and Thiruvallur, prompting police warnings and school closures.
A private water tanker hit a two-wheeler near Pallikaranai, killing a sixty-three-year-old woman on the spot and injuring her husband.
Pelican birds resting on high-voltage electricity towers in the Pallikaranai marshland frequently suffer fatal electric shocks, requiring TANGEDCO intervention.
The Tamil Nadu Vanigar Sanga Peramaippu Youth Wing organized an anti-drug awareness marathon event in Besant Nagar.
Cyclone Murasu moving toward the south Andhra Pradesh coast may bring moderate to heavy rainfall to Chennai and surrounding districts.
The twenty-two-kilometer Padi-Thiruninravur stretch of the Chennai-Thiruvallur Highway faces severe traffic congestion because the six-lane widening proposal remains delayed.
L&T’s Vyoma.AI started constructing a fifty-two megawatt AI data centre in Chennai, cementing the city's position as a digital hub.
MeitY launched the DEPA handbook to support secure data sharing for artificial intelligence training across digital platforms.
Google plans to invest one hundred sixty million dollars in water treatment and storage facilities in Malaysia to support its infrastructure.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 will bring founders and investors together on November fourteen at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway.
